subject: a0ea6918ba39a1bda
abstract: Fixed all round-1 REJECT findings. MAJOR-R1-1: isTrainTerminal now requires both car.stateRegister AND car.outcomeRegister to be nominal (was stateRegister only), closing the hole where a fully-returned train with a hot outcome (error, an unrecognised word, or done-with-findings) could be capped with zero residual signal, since dom-writer.js renders outcome as its own register-colored chip. REJECT still ages out correctly by doctrine, no special case added. Red-first: two new tests observed failing for the stated reason before the fix (train wrongly capped), green after, plus a REJECT control test. MINOR-R1-1: corrected a comment that wrongly attributed a closed liveness set to the wire schema itself rather than to board/fold; the schema deliberately leaves state open (Law 7). MINOR-R1-2: citation timestamp corrected to match the owner's body-text local time. MINOR-R1-3: two already-true conservative-path tests (unrecognised car state, zero-car train) pinned. NOTE-1: trains lane historySummary now uses the owner's exact ticket wording with no noun (a train is never literally returned on the wire); dispatches lane keeps returned. Re-verified with a real Playwright browser against the real Go server and an extended scratch-store fixture carrying a hot-outcome train dated oldest of all - observed it rendering first, surviving the cap, with its outcome chip showing error. Suite counts at commit c5858df: board/web node --test 169/169 (was 162/162), Go board/ 85/85 with clean go vet (untouched), Pester scripts/tests 223/227 passed 4 skipped 0 failed (both citation gates green), scripts/probes 24/24, probe-yard-snapshot.mjs PASS. Self-checked the diff for citation-coordinate risk per the #65 gate: no file:line numeric citations were introduced or shifted this round.
